2026 Storage/Price Later and Drying Rates
Storage Rates:
- Corn: $.23/bu until Jan 1st for fall deliveries & $.04/month 1/1/27 until 9/15/27 (Shrink to 14.5%)
- Soybeans: $.30/bu until Jan. 1st for fall deliveries & $.06/month 1/1/27 until 9/15/27

Priced Later:
- Corn: $.21/bu until Jan. 1st for fall deliveries & $.04/month 1/1/27 until 9/15/27 (Shrink to 15%)
- Soybeans: $.28/bu until Jan. 1st for fall deliveries & $.06/month 1/1/27 until 9/15/27
 *** All Price Later Fees are subject to change DAILY ***
 *** All rates are calculated on a daily basis after Jan. 1st, 2027***
***All grain remaining in storage and/or price later on 9/15/2027 will be charged with additional
minimum rates***

Shrink & Drying for Corn:
- 1.4%/pt moisture over 14.5% for Storage, over 15% for Priced Later/Cash Programs
- $.03/pt 14.6% - 25%
- $.04/pt 25.1% - 30%
- $.05/pt 30.1% - 35%

SEE NEXT PAGE FOR DISCOUNT SCHEDULE

                                *** All grades load by load ***

 All customers will have 10 days following the last load of grain
delivered to the elevator to decide whether to sell the grain or place
into open storage/price later program. If Earlville Farmers’ Co-op is
not contacted within the 10 day period, grain will automatically be
placed into the open storage program.
